title: Fix a backup script that breaks on unusual file names
instruction:
archive.sh is meant to copy files, but it breaks on unusual file names. Fix it.

Usage: sh archive.sh SRC DEST. It copies every regular file directly inside SRC (not files in subdirectories, and not files whose names start with a dot) into DEST, creating DEST and any missing parent directories. File names must be preserved exactly, including names with spaces, asterisks, question marks, dollar signs or a leading dash. SRC and DEST may contain spaces. It prints only the number of files copied. If SRC is not a directory, print a message to stderr and exit with status 2.

check.sh is a simple visible check. Do not edit it.
